title: card.time Request Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Retrieves current date and time information in UTC. Upon power-up, the Notecard must complete a sync to Notehub in order to obtain time and location data. Before the time is obtained, this request will return `{"zone":"UTC,Unknown"}`. The Notecard's stored timezone is only updated when a new Notehub session begins.

annotations.title: note
annotations.description: Different models of Notecard exhibit varying levels of clock drift depending on their hardware design and operating temperature. If you would like to calibrate your Notecard for your own known operating conditions, see the [Notecard Real-Time Clock application note](https://dev.blues.io/datasheets/application-notes/notecard-real-time-clock/#calibrating-the-rtc), which demonstrates how to use the Notecard CLI to perform such calibration.

samples.title: Get Current Time and Date
samples.description: Retrieve current date and time information in UTC with location data if available.
